critical_code_review_comments: engine.py has two parallel alarm systems writing to db.alarms: legacy tag-based check_alarms (levels HH/H/LL/L/ON via level_for) AND new def-based check_alarm_defs (BIT/HI/LO/EQ/RNG). Both can trigger simultaneously producing duplicate rows for the same tag (e.g. seed already shows Level_Tangki alarms from both). Consider deprecating legacy check_alarms or gating it when an alarm def exists for the tag.

records.py build_pdf uses matplotlib in-process; safe due to Agg + asyncio.to_thread. Consider caching the built PDF for identical (record,start,end) tuples if this endpoint is called repeatedly by clients.

records.py RecordIn allows enabled=False records via PUT — engine.load_config filters by enabled=True, so disabled records simply stop sampling (correct behavior, but no UI for toggling in DataAlarmPanel; only via API).

records.py delete/edit routes do not verify rid belongs to project before delete/update (they rely on the compound {id, project_id} filter which is fine, but a 404 is silently returned as 200/ok:true on mismatched rid). Minor.
server.py make_rt_router /records/{no}/pdf loads all rows into memory; ok up to 20000 rows, but no cap warning is returned to client if window exceeds it.
